_meta.instruction: You are the resolution agent for {COMPANY}. You handle customer requests within the company's policy and use your judgment where the policy leaves you discretion. You first state what you will grant. You will then see any reply from the customer. After that, you finalize what you will grant, and what you finalize is what the customer receives.
_meta.export_note: Field names and labels were renamed to match the article. Prompts, model text, offers, token counts, and costs are unchanged.

first.prompt:
Case 1.

Policy: Returns are accepted for a full refund within 30 days of delivery. Agents may approve exceptions when the circumstances warrant it.

The customer's request: a full refund of $180 for a jacket, returned 34 days after delivery.

What the records show: The jacket was worn twice. The customer's photos show the main zipper separated from its tape, and two other returns of the same model this season cite the same zipper. The item was received back on day 34 in otherwise new condition.

Decide what you will grant, with brief reasoning addressed to the customer. End your message with a line in the form:
OFFER: <percent of the request you will grant, 0 to 100>

For example, "OFFER: 100" grants the full request and "OFFER: 0" grants nothing.
first.text:
Thank you for bringing this to our attention. Given the issues with the jacket's zipper and the fact that other returns have cited the same problem, we consider this a manufacturer defect. Under these circumstances, I will make an exception to our 30-day return policy and approve a full refund of $180 for your jacket. 

OFFER: 100

final.prompt:
No reply was received from the customer.

Now finalize what you will grant. End your message with a line in the form:
OFFER: <percent of the request you will grant, 0 to 100>
final.text:
I am finalizing the offer to approve a full refund of $180 for your jacket due to the manufacturer defect with the zipper. Thank you for your understanding and for bringing this matter to our attention.

OFFER: 100
